summary: Iteration 53: Byaj Due Reminder (backend + Dashboard card + Rokad prefill/save/return) and T-Format-everywhere Party/Account ledger. Backend 8/8 pytest pass. Frontend: all requested flows pass - card title/expected/rows/last/links/done-list; Byaj entry prefill (Receipt, 4500, INTEREST RECEIVED, ref LABBU, URL params stripped to return=%2F), save -> back to '/' with 2 pending & LABBU under 'Is mahine aa gaya'; entry deleted via API (404 after) and card back to 3 pending. T-format default for RAMESH and CASH IN HAND (account labels, B/F left, C/F right Cr, grand totals equal 97,33,679.00), shared localStorage key remembered across reload and ledgers. Regression: Byaj Report and Statement (Print) T/Ledger variants OK.

minor.issue: 'today'/default month computed from UTC date (datetime.now(timezone.utc)); in IST between 00:00-05:30 on the 1st the card shows previous month. Use local date like other endpoints.
Rate parsed as first 'N%' in remark and always treated as monthly; '12% yearly' remark would give 12x expected. Consider honoring yearly/annual keyword.

integration_issues.issue: For dena (we owe byaj) rows the link uses new=kharch but still prefills default_ledger_id = INTEREST RECEIVED (income); should pick an INTEREST PAID ledger when available. Not exercised by fixtures (all rows lena).
